summary: D. Boral ARC Acquisition I Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval at its extraordinary general meeting of the Business Combination Proposal, Domestication Merger Proposal, and related governance matters. The approved business combination involves the merger of its merger sub with Exascale Labs Inc., resulting in Exascale surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the post-domestication Delaware PubCo. The meeting had 62.28% shareholder representation, with the business combination receiving 24,503,325 votes for, 1,120,108 against, and 35,000 abstentions. The domestication from BVI to Delaware was also approved. The filing is a standard SPAC de-SPAC update, with the closing remaining pending conditions. Watch for subsequent closing announcement and any redemptions.
